features: Add the protected `CommandService.getCommandAdmissionConditions` hook for atomic command admission. A `CommandService` subclass can return DynamoDB `ConditionCheck` entries, which are committed with the initial command write in a single `TransactWriteItems` request. A command is then accepted only if, for example, a maintenance gate is still open at the generation the request observed, which closes the race between a preflight gate check and a gate that closes in the meantime. The default returns no checks and keeps the plain `PutItem` path, so existing apps behave as before

Add `CommandAdmissionRejectedException` (HTTP 409) for a failed admission check and `CommandAdmissionContentionException` (HTTP 503) for a transaction cancelled by `TransactionConflict`. A version conflict on the command write is still reported as `ConditionalCheckFailedException` (409), and any other cancellation is rethrown as the original `TransactionCanceledException` (500). Core does not retry
The infrastructure template now grants `dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem` on the stack-prefixed DynamoDB tables, which the admission transaction needs on witness tables

breakingChanges: Require Node.js 22 or later (`engines.node` is now `>=22`). Node.js 18 and 20 are end of life and will not receive the fix for CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell), a remote code execution vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js. The fix ships in Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1. `@mbc-cqrs-serverless/core` also now depends on nodemailer 10, which itself requires Node.js 20 or later. CI tests Node.js 22 and 24

nodemailer 10 ships its own type definitions, and its default export is no longer a namespace. Code that uses `nodemailer.SendMailOptions`, `nodemailer.Transporter` or `nodemailer.SentMessageInfo` must import these types by name from `nodemailer` instead, and `@types/nodemailer` should be removed. Apps that only use `EmailService` need no code changes

New projects use Node.js 22. The Lambda function and layer use `NODEJS_22_X`, the Docker image is based on `node:22-bookworm-slim` and installs `openssl` (Prisma's query engine needs libssl, which bookworm-slim does not ship), the `infra-local` images use `node:22-alpine`, and `serverless.yml` uses `nodejs22.x` with serverless-offline `^13.9.0`. The CDK pipeline pins Node.js 22 for its CodeBuild projects, and `@types/node` moves to 22
security: Clear high and critical advisories in production dependencies: proxy-addr 2.0.8, body-parser 1.20.9 / 2.4.0, multer 2.5.0, nodemailer 10.3.1, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2, zod 4.6.7

The CLI project template's dependency overrides now also pin proxy-addr 2.0.8, body-parser 1.20.9 / 2.4.0 and multer 2.5.0, so newly scaffolded projects no longer ship these advisories. The `qs` override, in the framework and the template, moves to `^6.16.1`, the minimum that the patched body-parser and express 5 require

breakingChanges: Replace LocalStack with Floci (`floci/floci:1.6.0`) as the local S3 emulator in the scaffolded local development stack. LocalStack Community Edition reached end of life in March 2026. Floci serves S3 on the same port (`4566`) with path-style addressing, so application code and `.env` values do not change, and deployed environments are not affected
features: `DirectoryService` methods now take `ICommandOptions` instead of an options type that only allowed `invokeContext`, so callers can pass `source` and `requestId` through to the command for tracing. Backward compatible: `invokeContext` is still the only required field
bugFixes: Fix `mbc new` failing at dependency installation with `EOVERRIDE: Override for js-yaml@^4.1.0 conflicts with direct dependency` (broken since v1.3.5). The template's `js-yaml` override now references the direct dependency, which moves to `^4.3.2` and also clears a high-severity `js-yaml` advisory

Fix `npm run migrate` in newly scaffolded projects. Prisma does not expand the `:-` default syntax used for `LOCAL_RDS_PORT` in `DATABASE_URL` (`P1013`), and `prisma/ddb.ts` did not expand the endpoint variables at all (`Invalid URL`). Existing projects can apply the same fix: reference `LOCAL_RDS_PORT` without a `:-` default in `DATABASE_URL`, and load `.env` in `prisma/ddb.ts` with `expand(dotenv.config())` from `dotenv-expand`

Ship the Claude Code skills in the published npm package. They were missing from the package, so `mbc install-skills` and the manual `cp -r node_modules/@mbc-cqrs-serverless/mcp-server/skills/*` step could not find them

features: Make the DynamoDB table names of the domain modules configurable via a backward-compatible `tableName?` option, and add `registerAsync` support to all four modules. Defaults are unchanged (`master` / `directory` / `survey` / `master`), so existing apps upgrade with no code changes
